# Troubleshooting

Start with the problem the patron describes. Each section lists the most likely cause first.

## Wi-Fi won't connect

1. Check that the patron chose **ElmStreet-Public**, not a nearby network.
2. Ask them to open any website. The welcome page should appear; they must tap **Accept**.
3. If nothing happens, turn Wi-Fi off and on again on their device.
4. Still stuck? Restart the access point in the reading room. The full steps are in the [Network Setup guide](Network-Setup.md).

> [!NOTE]
> The Network Setup guide hasn't been written yet. Ask a supervisor until it's ready.

## Printing problems

| What the patron sees | Likely cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| "Job held" | Not paid yet | Send them to the kiosk |
| Nothing prints | Wrong printer chosen | Reprint to **Elm-Floor1** |
| Pages come out blank | Toner is low | Swap the cartridge (see the [[Printer Manual]]) |
| Pages are cut off | Wrong paper size | Choose **A4** in the print window |

## E-book loans

Most e-book problems happen because the patron's account and the e-book app are out of sync.

### "You have reached your loan limit"

The patron already has 10 e-books. Ask them to return one early from the app.

### "This title is not available"

Every copy is on loan. Offer to place a hold. The [[Glossary]] explains how holds work.

### The book downloaded but won't open

Ask the patron to sign out of the app and sign in again. This refreshes the licence.

## Public computer is frozen

Hold the power button for five seconds. The computer restarts and erases the session, as described in [Security](Security.md#public-computer-reset).

## Still not solved?

Write down what the patron saw, the time and the computer number, then pass it to the Digital Services Team.
